compiled_state.title: As an operator, I can verify provenance of all commits in a session PR to confirm every change was gated by per-branch CI review
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Build the provenance verifier script that checks every commit in the session→main PR traces to a sub-branch PR with a passing per-branch-review CI check, with exponential backoff for API rate limits and a SHA→PR cache for reruns.

**Why**: The provenance verifier is the enforcement mechanism for SC1. Without it, direct-to-session commits (bypassing per-branch-review.yml) go undetected, and the session→main PR would merge code that was never reviewed. Un-provenanced commits also feed the integration review scope (SC2/SC3).

**Scope**:
- IN: New script plugins/dso/scripts/verify-session-provenance.sh; uses 3-signal cross-check (git log trailer + gh api commits/<sha>/pulls + GitHub check status); exponential backoff (initial 2s, doubled per retry, cap 60s) on 403/429 responses; 200-call API budget ceiling (exits BUDGET_EXHAUSTED on exhaustion); SHA→PR cache stored in artifact to avoid re-querying on reruns; exits 0 when all commits provenanced; exits non-zero listing un-provenanced SHAs + routes them into integration review scope input file; explicit squash-merge resolution via DSO-Story-Merge trailer
- OUT: The integration review itself (S6); Ruleset enforcement (S3); migration script (S7)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, verify-session-provenance.sh exits 0 when all session-branch commits (main..session-HEAD) trace to a sub-branch PR whose per-branch-review check returned SUCCESS; verified by a fixture sprint where all commits are provenanced
  ← Satisfies: "Provenance integrity: every commit traces to a sub-branch PR with passing Per-Branch LLM Review" (SC1)
- When this story is complete, a synthetic direct-to-session commit causes verify-session-provenance.sh to exit non-zero, report the SHA, and write it to the integration review scope input file; verified by injecting a direct commit in the fixture
  ← Satisfies: SC1 (fixture b: synthetic direct-to-session commit exits non-zero)
- When this story is complete, the verifier uses exponential backoff (initial 2s, doubled per retry, cap 60s) on GitHub API 403/429 responses
  ← Satisfies: Operational Constraint (provenance retry/backoff)
- When this story is complete, the verifier enforces a 200-call API budget ceiling; exits non-zero with BUDGET_EXHAUSTED marker on exhaustion
  ← Satisfies: Operational Constraint (per-walk budget ceiling)
- When this story is complete, the SHA→PR cache is written to the artifact directory; a rerun of the verifier with the same session-HEAD does not re-query already-resolved SHAs
  ← Satisfies: Operational Constraint (per-session SHA→PR cache)
- When this story is complete, squash-merged sub-branch commits are resolved to their originating sub-branch PR via DSO-Story-Merge trailer (or gh API association) and treated as provenanced; verified by a fixture that squash-merges a story PR into session and asserts verifier exit 0
  ← Satisfies: SC6 (cafb-4b97 reproducer prerequisite)
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Reliability] GitHub API rate limiting is the primary runtime risk. Exponential backoff + cache are the mitigations. The 200-call budget prevents runaway API consumption on large sessions.
- [Maintainability] Squash-merge resolution requires the DSO-Story-Merge trailer written by S2's merge-story-branch.sh. The verifier must parse the trailer schema as documented in the contract file from S2. Add a contract test asserting the verifier correctly parses the trailer format.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
